data "aws_iam_policy_document" "wiz_assume_role" {
  statement {
    sid     = "WizCrossAccountAssumeRole"
    effect  = "Allow"
    actions = ["sts:AssumeRole"]

    principals {
      type        = "AWS"
      identifiers = [var.remote-arn]
    }

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "sts:ExternalId"
      values   = [var.external-id]
    }
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_role" "wiz_access" {
  name               = var.rolename
  description        = "Cross-account role granting the Wiz security auditing platform read-only access"
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.wiz_assume_role.json

  tags = local.common_tags
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "view_only_access" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.wiz_access.name
  policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/job-function/ViewOnlyAccess"
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "security_audit" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.wiz_access.name
  policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/SecurityAudit"
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "wiz_custom" {
  statement {
    sid       = "WizFullPolicy"
    effect    = "Allow"
    actions   = local.wiz_read_only_actions
    resources = local.all_resources
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "WizAccessEBS"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "ec2:CopySnapshot",
      "ec2:CreateSnapshot",
      "ec2:GetEbsEncryptionByDefault",
      "ec2:DescribeSnapshots",
    ]
    resources = local.all_resources
  }

  statement {
    sid       = "WizAccessEC2CreateTags"
    effect    = "Allow"
    actions   = ["ec2:CreateTags"]
    resources = ["arn:aws:ec2:*::snapshot/*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid     = "WizAccessKMSCreateAlias"
    effect  = "Allow"
    actions = ["kms:CreateAlias"]
    resources = [
      "arn:aws:kms:*:*:alias/wizKey",
      "arn:aws:kms:*:*:key/*",
    ]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "WizAccessKMSPolicy"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "kms:GetKeyPolicy",
      "kms:PutKeyPolicy",
    ]
    resources = local.all_resources

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "aws:ResourceTag/${local.wiz_tag_key}"
      values   = ["auto-gen-cmk"]
    }
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "WizAccessEC2Snapshots"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "ec2:DeleteSnapshot",
      "ec2:ModifySnapshotAttribute",
    ]
    resources = local.all_resources

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "ec2:ResourceTag/${local.wiz_tag_key}"
      values   = ["auto-gen-snapshot"]
    }
  }

  statement {
    sid       = "WizAccessS3"
    effect    = "Deny"
    actions   = ["s3:GetObject"]
    resources = local.all_resources
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "wiz_custom_policy" {
  name   = "WizCustomPolicy"
  role   = aws_iam_role.wiz_access.id
  policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.wiz_custom.json
}

output "role_arn" {
  description = "ARN of the Wiz cross-account role to register with the platform"
  value       = aws_iam_role.wiz_access.arn
}

output "role_name" {
  description = "Name of the Wiz cross-account role"
  value       = aws_iam_role.wiz_access.name
}

output "external_id" {
  description = "External ID configured in the role trust policy"
  value       = var.external-id
  sensitive   = true
}

# main.tf for terraform-bot IAM user with scoped EKS deployment policy
# Note: The AWS provider configuration (region = "us-east-1") is injected by the
# deployment harness and is intentionally omitted here to avoid a duplicate
# provider configuration error. No backend block is declared (managed externally).

terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 5.0"
    }
  }
}

variable "tags" {
  description = "Tags applied to every taggable resource in this configuration"
  type        = map(string)
  default = {
    ManagedBy = "terraform"
    Purpose   = "eks-deployment"
  }
}

locals {
  iam_path    = "/"
  user_name   = "terraform-bot"
  policy_name = "terraform-policy"
}

data "aws_partition" "current" {}

# Dedicated deployment identity. No login profile (console password) and no
# access key are created, so no secrets end up in configuration or state.
# If programmatic credentials are needed later, store them in
# aws_secretsmanager_secret / aws_secretsmanager_secret_version, never as plain text.
resource "aws_iam_user" "terraform_bot" {
  name = local.user_name
  path = local.iam_path
  tags = var.tags
}

# SECURITY NOTE: This statement uses Resource = "*" together with iam:PassRole
# and IAM role/policy write actions (CreateRole, AttachRolePolicy, PutRolePolicy,
# CreatePolicy, CreatePolicyVersion, UpdateAssumeRolePolicy, ...). That combination
# is broad and could allow privilege escalation. It is kept only because the
# request requires it. Narrow it later with resource ARN patterns
# (for example "arn:${data.aws_partition.current.partition}:iam::*:role/eks-*")
# and/or an iam:PassedToService condition on iam:PassRole.
resource "aws_iam_policy" "terraform_policy" {
  name        = local.policy_name
  path        = local.iam_path
  description = "Permissions for Terraform-controlled EKS cluster creation and management"

  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Sid    = "VisualEditor0"
        Effect = "Allow"
        Action = [
          # Auto Scaling
          "autoscaling:AttachInstances",
          "autoscaling:CreateAutoScalingGroup",
          "autoscaling:CreateLaunchConfiguration",
          "autoscaling:CreateOrUpdateTags",
          "autoscaling:DeleteAutoScalingGroup",
          "autoscaling:DeleteLaunchConfiguration",
          "autoscaling:DeleteTags",
          "autoscaling:Describe*",
          "autoscaling:DetachInstances",
          "autoscaling:SetDesiredCapacity",
          "autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup",
          "autoscaling:SuspendProcesses",

          # EC2 networking and compute
          "ec2:AllocateAddress",
          "ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses",
          "ec2:Associate*",
          "ec2:AttachInternetGateway",
          "ec2:AttachNetworkInterface",
          "ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress",
          "ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress",
          "ec2:CreateDefaultSubnet",
          "ec2:CreateDhcpOptions",
          "ec2:CreateEgressOnlyInternetGateway",
          "ec2:CreateInternetGateway",
          "ec2:CreateNatGateway",
          "ec2:CreateNetworkInterface",
          "ec2:CreateRoute",
          "ec2:CreateRouteTable",
          "ec2:CreateSecurityGroup",
          "ec2:CreateSubnet",
          "ec2:CreateTags",
          "ec2:CreateVolume",
          "ec2:CreateVpc",
          "ec2:DeleteDhcpOptions",
          "ec2:DeleteEgressOnlyInternetGateway",
          "ec2:DeleteInternetGateway",
          "ec2:DeleteNatGateway",
          "ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface",
          "ec2:DeleteRoute",
          "ec2:DeleteRouteTable",
          "ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup",
          "ec2:DeleteSubnet",
          "ec2:DeleteTags",
          "ec2:DeleteVolume",
          "ec2:DeleteVpc",
          "ec2:DeleteVpnGateway",
          "ec2:Describe*",
          "ec2:DetachInternetGateway",
          "ec2:DetachNetworkInterface",
          "ec2:DetachVolume",
          "ec2:Disassociate*",
          "ec2:ModifySubnetAttribute",
          "ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute",
          "ec2:ModifyVpcEndpoint",
          "ec2:ReleaseAddress",
          "ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress",
          "ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress",
          "ec2:UpdateSecurityGroupRuleDescriptionsEgress",
          "ec2:UpdateSecurityGroupRuleDescriptionsIngress",
          "ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate",
          "ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion",
          "ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate",
          "ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplateVersions",
          "ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates",
          "ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions",
          "ec2:GetLaunchTemplateData",
          "ec2:ModifyLaunchTemplate",
          "ec2:RunInstances",
          "ec2:TerminateInstances",

          # EKS
          "eks:CreateCluster",
          "eks:DeleteCluster",
          "eks:DescribeCluster",
          "eks:ListClusters",
          "eks:TagResource",
          "eks:UntagResource",
          "eks:UpdateClusterConfig",
          "eks:UpdateClusterVersion",
          "eks:DescribeUpdate",

          # IAM
          "iam:AddRoleToInstanceProfile",
          "iam:AttachRolePolicy",
          "iam:CreateInstanceProfile",
          "iam:CreateOpenIDConnectProvider",
          "iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole",
          "iam:CreatePolicy",
          "iam:CreatePolicyVersion",
          "iam:CreateRole",
          "iam:DeleteInstanceProfile",
          "iam:DeleteOpenIDConnectProvider",
          "iam:DeletePolicy",
          "iam:DeleteRole",
          "iam:DeleteRolePolicy",
          "iam:DeleteServiceLinkedRole",
          "iam:DetachRolePolicy",
          "iam:GetInstanceProfile",
          "iam:GetOpenIDConnectProvider",
          "iam:GetPolicy",
          "iam:GetPolicyVersion",
          "iam:GetRole",
          "iam:GetRolePolicy",
          "iam:List*",
          "iam:PassRole",
          "iam:PutRolePolicy",
          "iam:RemoveRoleFromInstanceProfile",
          "iam:TagRole",
          "iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy",

          # S3
          "s3:CreateBucket",
          "s3:DeleteBucket",
          "s3:DescribeJob",
          "s3:Get*",
          "s3:HeadBucket",
          "s3:List*",
          "s3:PutBucketAcl",
          "s3:PutBucketTagging",
        ]
        Resource = "*"
      }
    ]
  })

  tags = var.tags
}

resource "aws_iam_user_policy_attachment" "terraform_bot_custom" {
  user       = aws_iam_user.terraform_bot.name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.terraform_policy.arn
}

  user       = aws_iam_user.terraform_bot.name

output "terraform_bot_user_arn" {

}

output "terraform_policy_arn" {
  description = "ARN of the terraform-policy IAM policy"
  value       = aws_iam_policy.terraform_policy.arn
}
